decisions.rationale: statement authority cannot be represented by the v1 file ledger
typed semantic categories and per-item provenance are absent from v1
independently settleable criteria and typed oracle plans are absent from v1
criterion, failure, oracle, capability and dimension bindings are absent from v1
per-term semantic provenance is absent from v1
owners require one canonical compact review surface
readiness enum and authority ceiling remain compatible; internal basis is separate
candidate and source-analysis authority remain sufficient
owner disposition and acceptance authority remain sufficient
run-local mechanics are not extension contracts
hidden qualification material must remain evaluator-controlled
